conclusion: the build compiles brotli for compression only; there is no decoder object or linkable library to bind, and the presence of decode.h alone does not provide an implementation
evidence_boundary: whether the decoder .c sources ship in the tree was not confirmed; the host link timed out repeatedly before that check could complete, so no claim is made either way
not_done: no product code changed this round
product_impact: unchanged from R391: the request advertises gzip, deflate only, so a conforming server will not answer with br; a server that ignores negotiation is refused rather than decoded wrongly
question: why does this path refuse Content-Encoding br instead of decoding it, and what would it take
what_it_would_take: bring in the full brotli decoder sources, build them into the closure, extend the wheel packaging and add decode tests; that is a larger change than the earlier note implied
